usage: crg-daemon [-h] {start,stop,restart,status,logs,add,remove} ...

Multi-repo watch daemon for code-review-graph

positional arguments:
  {start,stop,restart,status,logs,add,remove}
    start               Start the daemon
    stop                Stop the daemon
    restart             Restart the daemon
    status              Show daemon status and configuration
    logs                Show daemon or per-repo logs
    add                 Add a repository to the daemon config
    remove              Remove a repository from the daemon config

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
start:
usage: crg-daemon start [-h] [--foreground]

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
  --foreground  Run in the foreground instead of daemonizing
stop:
usage: crg-daemon stop [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
restart:
usage: crg-daemon restart [-h] [--foreground]

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
  --foreground  Run in the foreground instead of daemonizing
status:
usage: crg-daemon status [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
logs:
usage: crg-daemon logs [-h] [--repo ALIAS] [--follow] [--lines LINES]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo ALIAS          Show logs for a specific repo (by alias)
  --follow, -f          Follow log output (tail -f)
  --lines LINES, -n LINES
                        Number of lines to show (default: 50)
add:
usage: crg-daemon add [-h] [--alias ALIAS] path

positional arguments:
  path           Path to the repository

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --alias ALIAS  Short alias for the repository (default: directory name)
remove:
usage: crg-daemon remove [-h] path_or_alias

positional arguments:
  path_or_alias  Repository path or alias to remove

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
